test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Who teaches you English?

options.text: Who has been taught you English?
By whom were you taught English?
By whom are you taught English?
By whom was English taught to you?

solution:
The correct answer is **"By whom are you taught English?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The given interrogative sentence is in Present Simple Tense and in Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing an interrogative sentence in Present SimpleTense from Active voice to Passive voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Complete the sentence with the subject and sign of Interrogation (?).
 
• In this case,** 'you'** is the object of the sentence, so it becomes the subject in passive voice, and 'are taught' is added before **'English'.**
 
• In sentences containing 'who', the passive starts with 'by whom'.
 
 
• Active Voice - Who + V1 + Object?
 
• Passive Voice - By whom + helping verb(is/are) + Object + V3?
 
 
 
• 'Teaches'(V1) will be converted to 'are you taught' (is/are + V3). 
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

Correct Passive Voice:__ *By whom are you taught English?*
